description.silhouette: Compact twin-duct service chassis with two broad side impellers, open front gripping jaws and a rear battery cassette
description.colors: Worn warm ivory enamel over petrol green paint, graphite mechanics, satin alloy, copper hydraulic lines and small mint worklights
description.anatomy: Strict orthographic top-down, weaponless and stationless. Separate beveled service panels, an inlaid wrench marking, recessed fasteners and sparse edge wear. Only the two counter-rotating impellers move.

standard.label: Aged ivory enamel, petrol green and satin alloy
